notes.title: Tower of Origin2-Worm's Nest Game Strategy
notes.content:
Chapter 1-Worm Nest Stage
1. After completing the dialogue at the front desk of the guild, go to Items→Important Items→Letter of task . Trigger the follow-up plot

2. After reaching the 12th floor, follow the corpse and enter the mine cave

3. After entering the mine, a battle (must lose) will be triggered [Get CG].

4. There are only two things you can do in the first 5 days of being caught in jail

    ①Wake up every day and be taken to remodeling [obtained CG]

    ② come back and cut the wall

  After a cg is triggered twice, it can be skipped. No need to read it over and over again.

5. When the second spawning comes back (the fifth day), the wall is cut open, and the labyrinth area comes out from the hole.

   Walking along the road will trigger the plot. The parasite will be attached to you, [u]you can talk to the parasite to get the task guide[/u]

   From the 6th day onwards, you can go to the maze to explore and find the secret room every day after the transformation.

   Turn on the three switches in turn on the first floor of the maze (red→yellow→blue) to open the second floor entrance

   On the second floor of the maze, first go to the tentacles to trigger a dialogue.

Collect 4 heavy objects and put them on the mine cart. Then push the minecart to clear the road

Find a secret room near the water, go get an empty bucket, return to the waterside after getting the empty bucket, you can wading into the room.

6. Go to the secret delivery room up to 3 times, which is very helpful for the final boss fight.

7. When there is an obscene pattern [there will be a CG after being taken away that morning], the parasite will remind you that a decisive battle is about to come,

   If you went to the secret delivery room more than 3 times before, the parasite will say "Fortunately before you..." If it is not enough, it will say: ‘You must go again...’

8. The second day of the kinky pattern plot will enter the last day of the Worm Nest stage, and the following branches will appear

    ①If you were not possessed by parasites in the early stage, flying worms will come and take you away, the seedbed ending [obtained CG]

    ②Participated in the plan of parasites, aliens come to take you away and enter the final battle

9. In the final battle, the treasure chest in the upper left corner of the maze area has a staff, and the treasure chest in the upper right corner has a ring. The palace is in the lower right corner.

10. After entering the palace, if you go to the secret delivery room 3 times in the early stage, you will directly fight the insect king, and you will get extra damage.

     If it does not reach three times, you need to fight the alien guarding the palace first, and then fight the insect king.

     If you lose the battle, you will enter the seedbed ending. Conquer and enter the next chapter.

Chapter 2-Academy Stage
There are a lot of CG in this chapter.

1. Follow the plot and go back to the 9th floor room first.

2. You can find the union (a big house with a wooden roof) along the road when you go out, and the well can lead to a hidden map

3. After the union handed in the task, follow the plot and enter the college.

4. First go to the female dormitory on the left side of the second floor of the college, talk to the aunt in red at the door, and then enter the innermost room. Talk to the bright bed.

5. After taking the water course [obtained cg] following the plot, go to the men's toilet on the right side of the second floor to trigger the second plot

6. After the men's toilet comes out, it's night time, and fly out of the campus at the damaged place in the lower right corner of the campus. The nightclub next to it will be part-time in the evening [Get CG]

7. At the end of the guide, enter the free phase. no time limit. There is a progress bar in the upper right corner

8. The college is divided into four time periods: morning→noon→afternoon→evening.

   In the morning and afternoon, you can choose to have classes in the classroom (water, fire and wind) or skip class in the playground (the flowers in the lower left corner).

    Each place has 4 stages of the story, and after each stage of the story happens twice, you can enter the next stage.

    E.g:

    The plot progress of the water class is: touch (after two times) → mouth (after two times) → 3P (after two times) → more P in four stages

9. At night, you can go to nightclubs to work part-time. It is also a four-stage progressive plot.

10. Coco's diary on the library, men's bathroom, office door, and bedroom table at noon. There are branch plots in four places

11. When the official plot (water, fire and wind + truant + nightclub) completes any three (the progress bar reaches 90%), the free time ends

12. The next day after the progress bar reaches 90%, when you get up in the morning, there will be flying insects to sell goods, and you will enter the boss battle.

13. If the boss fight fails, you will be locked in the principal’s magic space, [Get CG]

     The boss wins the battle and enters the next chapter of the plot.

Chapter Three-Assassination Phase
1. The first target of the assassination is a general.

     Fight with the guards, if you lose the battle, there will be [Bad CG]

     There is an egg npc in the upper left corner of the barracks for you a secret small burger.

     Enter all the tents, trigger the animation, and trigger the steam achievement [Army Red Leaf] (Army Green Flower)

     Fight with the generals, if you lose, you will be arrested and tortured [obtained cg]

2. The second target of the assassination was Grand Duke Zieg

      Follow the storyline [Get CG]

      The Chijia Guardian will release the Frozen Seal Skill, which can be unlocked by using the Flame Cloak.

      Each Chijia Guardian can use the Frozen Skill up to 5 times.

      After the Zieg mission is completed, you will [get CG]

3. The third target of the assassination is Quancheng

       After being arrested on the initiative [Get CG]

       There is no CG in the battle of Kwonseong

4. If all three assassinations fail, the Insect King will lose trust in you and throw you into the spawning room to fend for itself [with CG]

   As long as there is a victory, you can enter the next chapter.

Chapter 4-Final Chapter
1. Follow the plot to guard the campus and trigger a battle with elite guards.

    If the generals are not killed during the assassination phase, they will fight with the generals at the end.

2. Come to the principal’s room, enter the magic crystal, talk to the principal, and learn how to become a transcendant [get CG]

3. After becoming a transcender, choose whether to resist or obey.

    If you resist. You will be teleported to the battlefield to fight the insect king.

         Defeat the insect king, the general will draw you to join the human camp,

             Putting on the ring will eventually be poisoned to death.

             If you don’t wear the ring, you will fight with the general. After defeating the general, you will enter the queen finale [Get CG]

      If you obey, you will teleport to the battlefield and fight with the generals.

            Defeat the general, you will be treated as an abandoned son, and you will be corrupted forever [get CG]



End

The words written at the back:

I personally made it. It is inevitable that there are omissions. If you encounter a bug, please tell me so that I can fix it.

QQ: 756351705

if you think it's okay, please help me to promote it~
